sketch.name: EthanolPriceBoard
sketch.description: An ethanol price board: spot prices at the trading hubs in $/gal, each with its change on the day, a 10-day trend line and its basis to Chicago, under a strip of benchmarks (CBOT corn, RBOB, Chicago ethanol futures).

props.name: columns
props.description: How many hub tiles share a row.

props.name: referenceHub
props.description: Id of the hub the basis is measured against (usually Chicago Argo).

props.name: showBasis
props.description: Shows each hub's basis to the reference hub.

props.name: showBenchmarks
props.description: Shows the benchmark strip above the tiles.

props.name: asOf
props.description: When the prices were taken, shown under the tiles.

props.name: hubs
props.description: Hubs: { id, hub, price ($/gal), change (on the day), history (oldest first) }.

props.name: benchmarks
props.description: Benchmarks: { name, price, unit, change, decimals }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no designer-edited items): hubs and benchmarks are data rows. Basis = hub price − reference hub price (the reference tile is marked REF). Sparkline green when the last point is above the first, red when below; change badges green up, red down, grey unchanged. Prices to 4 decimals. Sparklines drawn as small SVGs; tiles, strip and badges as native widgets. Colours from the GridKrafter palette (green, red, violet). Meant for a GridBoard card about 7 columns x 5 rows.
